_comment: Non-secret app settings, safe to commit. The API keys live in apiKeyEtoro.json next to this file (git-ignored); env vars override both. ollamaModel enables the bot simulation's LOCAL-model proposal source (REQ-F-030) — the bot still ignores it until you pick confirm/lead in the Bot sim window; install with ./setup.sh ollama. botDailyTarget / botDailyLossLimit are the bot's daily stopping rules in EUR of BOOKED net (REQ-F-031): reaching either stops opening for that day, 0 switches a rule off, and TRADINGAPP_BOT_TARGET / TRADINGAPP_BOT_LOSS_LIMIT override them.
